# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.30

<!-- update-summary: Protect transfer output ownership and share quotas; preserve URL hash routes and encrypted-share keys while redacting them from logs. -->

## Fixes

- Assemble received files into uniquely reserved temporary files, so a manifest filename cannot collide with another item's assembly path or overwrite an existing file. Cleanup only removes temporary files created by the current operation.
- Reject an over-limit source before consuming the Internet Share backend's global creation budget.
- Preserve URL fragments for newly captured links and device handoff. Hash-based navigation and encrypted-share keys are no longer removed from actionable URLs; concise display metadata still omits the fragment.
- Redact URL fragments from diagnostic logs, including encrypted-share keys.

## Compatibility and validation

Beta 29 is the immediate upgrade baseline. Existing data and preferences are
preserved. Previously stripped URL metadata is not rewritten; recopy an affected
link to capture its complete URL. Update both devices for fragment-preserving URL
handoff; older receivers may reject such URLs under their old normalization rule.

Worker-source changes require an operator to deploy the updated Worker; updating
the desktop application alone does not update a separately hosted backend.

The existing real Windows CI, native tests, installer/upgrade/uninstall, packaging,
security and release integrity gates remain required for the final candidate.
Local Linux checks are not Windows-native acceptance. Manual multi-device and
operator-hosted Worker acceptance remain unverified unless separately recorded.
This review does not certify that all possible bugs have been eliminated.
